nippert-stadium.mobility.1: ADA seating is available across Nippert Stadium, in Sections 101-113, 115-117, 125-127, 131-132 and Premium Sections 333, 334, 337, and 344.
nippert-stadium.mobility.3: Parking for patrons needing accessible parking is available in Woodside Garage for a rate of $25 (credit/debit card only). A golf cart shuttle from Woodside Garage to a drop off point near the stadium will be provided. A state-issued handicap pass is required. For more information, call (513) 556-2283.
nippert-stadium.chronic.2: ALL INDIVIDUALS AND THEIR BELONGINGS ARE SUBJECT TO SEARCH. THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE WITHOUT NOTICE. Fans with medical bags or items they must carry with them must be inspected and either have a wristband or sticker placed on it to show that it has been inspected. PLEASE ARRIVE EARLIER TO AVOID LAST MINUTE GATE PRESSURE.
nippert-stadium.chronic.3: Re-entry is not permitted at any Nippert Stadium event. In case of emergency, guests can contact the ticket taker and/or security supervisor at the nearest gate.
First Aid rooms are staffed by trained medical personnel provided by UC Health. Locations are behind sections 117, 111 and in Victory Plaza as well as in the Club level in the West Pavilion.
nippert-stadium.cognitive.1: For non-emergency help on gameday, fans can text (513) 450-8556 for assistance.

Additionally, any student, employee or visitor who is d/Deaf or hard of hearing can request ASL Interpreters for any UC event, including athletics events, using our online request form: ASL/CART request . Visitors who need other access or disability-related accommodations can email our accessibility office at AccessResources@uc.edu and we will work together with campus partners to coordinate access.
nippert-stadium.chronic.4: Lockers are available free of charge outside of Gate B and Gate J, perfect for storing items that cannot be brought into the stadium on gameday.
nippert-stadium.cognitive.2: Service animals are permitted in Nippert Stadium.
A service animal is a dog that is individually trained to perform work or tasks for a person with a disability.
Emotional support, comfort, and companion animals are not considered service animals under this policy and are not permitted in the stadium.
fifth-third-arena.sensory.1: UC offers captioning at multiple live sporting events and venues including football, men's and women's basketball, and volleyball; open captions on all pre-corded videos on the main video board; and the opportunity to access live captioning on smart phones (which can be accessed at Fifth Third Streamtext link during games).

Additionally, any student, employee or visitor who is d/Deaf or hard of hearing can request ASL Interpreters for any UC event, including athletics events, using our online request form: ASL/CART request. Visitors who need other access or disability-related accommodations can email our accessibility office at AccessResources@uc.edu and we will work together with campus partners to coordinate access.
fifth-third-arena.chronic.1: Fifth Third Arena follows the University of Cincinnati's Service Animal and Emotional Support Animal Policy, which can be viewed HERE .
fifth-third-arena.chronic.2: Exceptions to this policy will be made for all medically necessary items after proper inspection.
fifth-third-arena.chronic.3: There is no re-entry at Fifth Third Arena.
fifth-third-arena.chronic.4: Emergency medical personnel are on duty at each athletics event. Medical personnel can be contacted during an event by notifying the nearest event staff member, usher, or security guard and informing them of the situation and location of the incident. The first-aid center is located on the north side of the arena on the main-level concourse by the Armory Bar.
A nursing suite is located on the main-level concourse on the north side behind section 109.
Wheelchair accessibility throughout the museum's exhibition galleries and theater and wheelchair accessible restrooms.
Manual wheelchair rentals free of charge, available on a first-come, first-served basis.

The parking garage underneath Great American Ball Park is called the Central Riverfront Garage, and can be accessed from the Pete Rose Way entrance (at the corner of Pete Rose Way and Broadway), the Mehring Way entrance (facing the Ohio River) and the Joe Nuxhall Way entrance (across from the Museum building). It can also be accessed on Mehring Way underneath the Moerlein Lager House.
Once inside the garage, follow the signs for the Hall of Fame and Museum to access the elevator and stairwell that leads to the Hall of Fame entrance.
Open captioning on all video presentations throughout the museum.
The museum is equipped with an assisted listening system for the hearing impaired. Headsets are available for use free of charge at the museum's box office.
Large format museum gallery floor plans are available free of charge upon request at the museum's box office.

The Cincinnati Reds Hall of Fame and Museum presented by Dinsmore is a 16,000 sq. ft. facility with exhibit galleries located on two floors. Please allow at least 45-60 minutes for your self-guided tour.

It can also be accessed on Mehring Way underneath the Moerlein Lager House.
